transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've ruined things for everyone. I've been really falling behind at work, and I've kind of lost control of my apartment situation lately. It just... it feels like I deserve whatever bad thing happens to me next.
Have you experienced these feelings of worthlessness and difficulty functioning in the past, or is this the first time you have felt this way?

It's really just been this one continuous stretch. I haven't felt like this in the past, but this current situation has been going on for about a year and two months now. 

It all started... well, ever since a pipe burst at my old place. It forced me to move into this much smaller apartment, and my daily routines just completely fell apart after that. I haven't been able to get back on track since it happened.
Over this past year, have you experienced any persistent changes in your sleep patterns or your appetite?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely been an issue. I'll usually just... lie there in bed for hours, mostly just listening for noises around the apartment. When I do finally manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. And I wake up already tense and just exhausted. It's kind of like I never really powered down for the night. As for my appetite, I haven't really noticed a major change there, but getting actual rest has been really tough.
Have you felt this way consistently for more than two years, or has this been limited to the last fourteen months since the pipe burst?

No, not two years. It's really just been limited to the last fourteen months. Like I was saying, it's been about a year and two months... right when that pipe burst happened and I was forced to move into the smaller apartment. Before that, I was doing okay, but that's when all my routines completely fell apart, and it's just been a constant struggle ever since.
Over these past fourteen months, have you found that you are no longer able to enjoy the activities or hobbies that you used to find pleasurable?

Yeah, that's... that's definitely been happening. Most days I just wake up with this really flat, heavy sadness. It's like... the things that used to sort of reset me or help me unwind just don't work anymore. I used to like putting on a record, or cooking a nice meal, or even just tinkering with some electronics... but lately, it's like those things just don't reach me. I try to do them, but I don't feel anything from it.

Looking back further than these past fourteen months, have you ever had a separate period in your life, perhaps years ago, where you felt this same persistent sadness and loss of interest for several weeks or more?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days or maybe a tough week here and there, like anyone else, but nothing like this. Before the move, I was pretty steady. I've never had a time where I felt this down or just... empty for weeks on end. This is the first time it's ever been this bad or lasted this long.
